channel.title: Dallas Next Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Dallas Next Media (dallasinnovates.com)

item.title: Bell Textron All Set to Build a $632M Army Assault Aircraft Parts Factory in North Fort Worth
item.description: Bell Textron will build a $632M factory in Fort Worth to produce parts for the U.S. Army’s MV-75 aircraft, supporting defense manufacturing growth in North Texas.

item.title: BNSF Railway Breaks Ground on New Logistics Center in Gunter
item.description: BNSF Railway broke ground on a 944-acre logistics center in Gunter, expanding rail access and supply chain capacity across North Texas.

item.title: 'It's All in the Name': Hotels.com Is Looking for a Room Service Critic, Robe Researcher, and Gym Rater
item.description: Hotels.com dream jobs include roles like room service critic and robe researcher, offering winners a $5,000 travel experience.

item.title: Dallas-Based Trinity Consultants Acquires Tennessee's Process Improvement Institute
item.description: Trinity Consultants acquisition of Process Improvement Institute expands its process safety and risk management consulting capabilities.

item.title: Dallas' Kane & Company Appoints New D.C‑Based Partner and COO, New Dallas Partner
item.description: Kane & Company has appointed Stuart Skeates and Jacob Hormes as partners, expanding its leadership team and opening a Washington, D.C. office.

item.title: RealPage Appoints Fintech Veteran as Its First Chief Fintech Officer
item.description: RealPage has appointed Zahir Khoja as its first Chief Fintech Officer to lead financial technology strategy, payments, and financial services operations.

item.title: The Last Word: Micron VP On Why Richardson Students Are 'a Direct Part of Our Industry's Future'
item.description: Micron Foundation has awarded a $96,500 STEM grant to Richardson ISD to support robotics, coding, and AI-focused learning for elementary students.

item.title: Calendar: Not-to-Miss Events for Innovators in Dallas-Fort Worth
item.description: North Texas has plenty to see, hear, and watch. Here are our editors' picks. Plus, you'll find more selections to "save the date."

item.title: Dallas' Jacobs Completes $1.6B Acquisition of Remaining Stake in London's PA Consulting
item.description: Since Jacobs took a 65% stake in PA Consulting in 2021, the London-based company has helped expand Jacobs' footprint and services in advisory, digital, data and technology-enabled solutions, reinforcing the company's work in infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, energy and life sciences.

item.title: McKinsey Exec To Join CBRE as Chief Technology & Transformation Officer
item.description: In addition to advising some of the world's leading AI, cloud, and technology companies on key strategies, M&A, and commercial operations, Anuj Kadyan has led large-scale technology and AI transformations for major companies in other industries, Dallas-based CBRE said.
